Systolic array (matmul accelerator)

The matmul accelerator is a 16×16 systolic array. It tiles each matmul internally onto the 16×16 array, and it also enables tiling at the software level, so matrices larger than the array are split into tiles in software and run as a sequence of matmuls.

Measured throughput on the DE1-SoC (N×N int8 matmul), systolic array vs CPU baseline:
- 64×64: 6.043 vs 1.255 GOP/s (4.82×)
- 128×128: 11.392 vs 1.382 GOP/s (8.24×)
- 256×256: 18.302 vs 1.442 GOP/s (12.69×)
- 512×512: 18.884 vs 1.454 GOP/s (12.99×)

Full table: ECE496 Files & Data → Matmul throughput: CPU baseline vs systolic array.
